products.body:
Unleash the true potential of your car audio system with the JP23 V2 Monoblock Amplifier. This all-new version is 23% smaller than its predecessor, yet packs an impressive punch with 2800W RMS power at 1-OHM. Engineered in Dunnellon, FL, and Las Vegas, Nevada, and assembled by passionate car audio enthusiasts, this amplifier ensures exceptional performance and durability. Elevate your driving experience with the JP23 V2 BLACK's power, style, and superior construction. Watch the amp dyno video in the videos tab to witness its impressive performance.

Key Features:

  • 2800W RMS power at 1-OHM for high-quality sound reproduction
  • Sleek black color and aluminum bass knob for added style
  • Upgraded thermal management with quiet high-speed cooling fans
  • Compact design, 23% smaller than the previous JP23 version
  • Versatile functionality with power clip, protect, and voltage features

Specifications:

  • RMS power, 1 ohm: 2800W x 1 @ 14.4V
  • RMS power, 2 ohms: 1800W x 1 @ 14.4V
  • RMS power, 4 ohms: 800W x 1
  • RMS power, 2 ohm Linked: 5600W x 1
  • Frequency Response: 10Hz - 270Hz
  • Low Pass Filter: 35Hz - 250Hz
  • Subsonic Filter: 10Hz - 50Hz
  • Bass Boost: 0-9 dB
  • Input sensitivity: 6V - 0.2V
  • Signal to Noise Ratio: 97dB
  • T.H.D @ 4 ohm: less than 0.1%
  • Single unit fuse rating: 300A
  • Strapped fuse rating: 600A
  • Length x Width x Height (inches): 13.38" x 7.40" x 2.24"
  • STRAPPABLE DIGITAL MONOBLOCK AMPLIFIER
  • STABLE INTO 1OHM MONO LOAD
  • HIGH-SPEED MOSFET POWER SUPPLY
  • VARIABLE LOW PASS FILTER
  • VARIABLE SUBSONIC FILTER
  • 4 WAY PROTECTION CIRCUITS: THERMAL, HIGH & LOW VOLTAGE, SPEAKER SHORT AND DC
  • Made in China

Upgrade Your Car Audio: Upgrade your car audio system with the JP23 V2 Monoblock Amplifier. Designed for power and style, this high-performance amp promises an immersive audio experience like never before. Enjoy peace of mind with the durable construction and advanced thermal management.
